text:
kevin: Heads-up: we started seeing onboarding failures for GPU warm-pools in eu-west an hour ago. symptoms look like heavy egress/auth churn from the keystore side.

ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-crossacct-export euw: burst exports x480 in 20m; privatelink nat conntrack approaching table_full. trigger=warmpool-onboard-fail(27).

saira: Can someone paste the node logs? want to confirm conntrack vs upstream timeouts.

kevin: node-euw-11 tail: 
```
2026-04-10T10:12:01Z kubelet: warmup: failed GET /keystore/meta -> timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
keystore-exporter euw->acct-12345 POST /export status=504 latency=1320ms
```

matt: This looks like a cross-account export storm. Recent change merged per-tenant audit exports into a per-account stream; some tenants are in other AWS accounts so traffic is crossing privatelink -> NAT -> egress. That multiplies conntrack state and egress QPS.

julia: Quick diag: cloud billing shows a spike in inter-account egress for eu-west on keystore service starting ~09:30Z. estimated incremental egress ~$12.4k/mo at current rate.

saira: Short-term mitigations: 1) temporary stop cross-account exports for non-critical tenants (can flip via feature flag), 2) bump nf_conntrack_max on privatelink NATs, 3) route exports through an aggregator inside the same account to remove NAT hops.

matt: Commands to bump conntrack on NAT hosts (one-off):
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=300000
# monitor
cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count
```

kevin: Security/compliance: we can't just 'stop' audit exports without an exception. @security-bot we need a fast-track exception if we do a scoped pause. will document re-audit plan.

security-bot: [REQ] emergency exception required for pausing exports across accounts. open ticket COMPL-9001 with justification and re-ingest plan.

julia: If we apply the aggregator pattern (single export collector in keystore-account), we eliminate cross-account egress and reduce export QPS by ~60% because we de-dupe duplicate meta. rough savings: egress down ~$9k/mo. infra dev time ~3d.

saira: Proposed immediate runbook: A) apply a per-tenant feature-flag to disable cross-account export for non-critical tenants (rollout 5m), B) bump conntrack_max on nat-euw for 4h, C) deploy an aggregator sidecar to 10% of exporter replicas to validate de-dupe, D) open COMPL-9001 and tag Security. Monitor for 30m.

matt: I'll PR the flag toggle and the aggregator sidecar image. kevin, please kick off conntrack bump on NAT fleet. julia, add the cost delta to COMPL ticket.

kevin: Running conntrack bump now on nat-euw fleet. initial conntrack_count=188210. Pushing sysctl change via fleet-runner.

ops-bot: [INFO] conntrack_max updated. new_max=300000. conntrack_count=189800 -> growth rate slowed.

julia: Monitoring billing: egress QPS down ~35% after feature-flag pause on 30% tenants. projected monthly incremental now ~$3.8k/mo. Will attach spreadsheet.

saira: Good signal. Deploying aggregator sidecar to 2/10 exporter pods as canary. will watch for latency/regressions.

matt: Sidecar canary up. initial results: duplicate export rate reduced 58%, exporter 5xxs down, warm-pool join success improved from 18% -> 78%.

security-bot: [APPROVE] temporary scoped pause for non-critical cross-account exports granted for 3h under COMPL-9001. condition: logs and re-ingest verification within 48h.

julia: Noting finance: if we keep aggregator permanently and consolidate accounts, expected monthly savings ~-$8.6k, but one-time infra dev ops ~3d and SRE rollout ~1d. Put numbers in the ticket.

kevin: Region fallback plan if eu-west still noisy: route new GPU allocations to eu-central for next 12-24h. prefer not to, but it's available.

saira: Follow-ups: (matt) complete aggregator rollout plan and PR, (julia) attach cost calc & billing graphs to COMPL-9001, (kevin) verify conntrack stable and revert bump after 4h, (ops) add runbook entry for cross-account export changes.

ops-bot: [RESOLVE] alert suppressed after canary: exporter 504s dropped to baseline, conntrack count stabilized. remember to remove temporary exception and run re-audit.

matt: I'll open PLAT-14577 for aggregator work and schedule 2-day sprint to finish. Keeping thread for short updates only.

kevin: thanks all. closing in 1h unless regressions.
